title: UK DMO pilot switch auction — a GEMM familiarisation TEST only; no gilts transferred, issued or cancelled
source: EST: dmo.gov.uk/media/ddejgfzz/pr170726.pdf — UK Debt Management Office press notice of 17 July 2026, 'UPDATE ON PLANNED SYNDICATION AND SWITCH AUCTION IN SEPTEMBER 2026; FEEDBACK SOUGHT ON A PROGRAMMATIC GILT TENDER IN JULY 2026', fetched direct 2026-09-15 (HTTP 200, 157.8KB PDF, text extracted locally). Under the heading 'Planned test switch auction on Thursday 24 September 2026' it reads verbatim: 'The DMO is also announcing today that the pilot switch auction planned for Thursday 24 September 2026 will take place as a test to be conducted with the Gilt-edged Market Makers (GEMMs). This will enable the GEMMs to familiarise themselves with the bidding and allocation processes. No gilts will be transferred, issued or cancelled as part of this test. Further details of the arrangements for the test will be shared with the GEMMs closer to the date of the test.' Stays estimate on one mechanical count, not on date doubt: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts (IR:/CAL:/BLS:/FED:/PJM:/SEC:/TSY:/OCC:/BEA:/CENSUS:/ISM:/CB:/UMICH:/FHFA:) has no slot for a non-US sovereign debt office, the same limit jgb-20y-auction-2026-09-15, ecb-decision-2026-09-10 and boj-decision-2026-09-18 all recorded. The DMO's own events calendar (dmo.gov.uk/calendars/events-calendar/) was BLOCKED the same session — a 302 into a ShieldSquare/perfdrive bot-validation interstitial — so this rests on the press notice alone, which is a DMO primary. Checked 2026-09-15
notes: PROPOSED BY THE boe-decision-2026-09-17 LANE AT ITS 2026-09-15 D-2 PULSE, AND THE POINT OF FILING IT IS A CORRECTION. This lane's 2026-09-09 initial research HUNTED a '~2026-09-24 DMO pilot switch auction' and deliberately did NOT propose it: single aggregator, no DMO primary, and a guessed date is worse than a gap. The primary has now been read, and it changes what the date means rather than merely confirming it. The market context that made 09-24 interesting was leg 5 of the parent ledger: coverage reporting the DMO 'exploring whether to absorb long-dated gilts from the Bank of England's balance sheet' while it cut long conventional issuance to GBP 23bn (~9% of 2026-27) on 'declining structural demand for long-dated gilts from domestic pension funds'. A switch auction is exactly the instrument that would do that absorbing, so 09-24 looked like a live supply event one week after the BoE's annual QT review. The DMO primary says it is not: the 24 September operation is a TEST with the Gilt-edged Market Makers to familiarise them with bidding and allocation, and 'No gilts will be transferred, issued or cancelled as part of this test.' Tiered LOW on exactly that sentence — an operation that moves no stock cannot move supply, and its information content is procedural (the DMO is building the plumbing for future switch auctions), not directional. Filed anyway because the procedural fact is the useful one: any later session reading a 09-24 gilt move must NOT attribute it to this operation, and the existence of tested switch-auction plumbing is a standing input to the same long-end supply question the parent ledger tracks. NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED: symbols: [], no house playbook is rates- or sterling-keyed, and estimate widens caution only — it licenses no date-keyed action.
